correctness.rationale: For k>=3 the hub link has exactly the faces (I,J) with 1+|I|+|I intersection J|<=r. Fiberwise toggling of an outer leaf with missing inner endpoint is a valid perfect acyclic matching outside the all-inner fiber; a final toggle leaves C(k-1,r-k-1) critical faces in a single dimension. The deletion of the hub is a simplex for r>=2, so suspension proves the ordinary wedge type. The invariant subcomplex omitting any inner vertex is contractible; its relative integral chain complex is sgn tensor the truncated augmented simplex complex, with top kernel exterior^h U_k, giving the equivariant integral lattice and torsion freeness. The r=1 join argument gives the sign module. The independently enumerated small complexes, Hasse matching DAGs and signed Lefschetz calculations all match the formulas.

value.rationale: The tree is the canonical depth-two subdivided star, the smallest natural departure from a fully whiskered star at its branching center. The theorem identifies a non-obvious contiguous contractible range, an exact binomial sphere sequence thereafter, and two rank-one stages with different integral orientation characters. The complete equivariant lattice is a structural invariant for every r in an infinite family, rather than a finite catalog or known-table recomputation.
